items.title: Willie Foster Interview
items.q: We hired a couple of other fellas from Smokebin, a place down there, one of them played guitar. And then go play to Donelsonville and get a trombone player called Louie Butter.

ctx.x: And they used to pay us a dollar and a half at night. Of course, I couldn't take my money then, but Daddy, he gave the money. We did the work. We hired a couple of other fellas from Smokebin, a place down there, one of them played guitar. And then go play to Donelsonville and get a trombone player called Louie Butter. Louie Butter, trombone player. Played vowel trombone. And it kept on and ended when I left home. I gave it up for a while, and I'd taken it up again when I was 18 years old. And then we started with…
Was that a dance band or a brass band?
